title: GetRadioVolume - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script

Returns the volume of this radio receiver.

Syntax:
float Function GetRadioVolume() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
The current volume this radio is set to. (0.0 to 1.0)

Examples:
Debug.Trace("The radio's volume is set to: " + radio.GetRadioVolume())
